publication_year_note: Published May 12, 2026 in PLOS Water 5(5): e0000544 (Received: April 16, 2025; Accepted: April 2, 2026; Copyright 2026).
rationale: Study S042 is a qualitative case study of six IDP sites and neighbouring host communities in Hargeisa, Somaliland, based on 12 focus group discussions with IDPs (n = 96) and 10 semi-structured interviews with host community households (total N = 106), analysed via thematic coding in NVivo following Braun and Clarke (2006). Aside from descriptive background figures, site characteristics (Table 2), participant demographic counts (Table 3), and a schedule of observed water prices by source in May 2024 (Table 5, noting IDPs pay over five times piped tariff rates), the paper conducts zero inferential statistical tests, regressions, correlations, or uncertainty estimation. Any quantitative synthesis eligibility flag would be overstated.
